overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation in the committee's continued withholding of four 2011 executive session minutes during ongoing collective bargaining, and declined to review new allegations not raised at the local level; the matter was closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to publicly release its July-September 2011 executive session minutes after the purpose for continued nondisclosure expired.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee is engaged in an ongoing collective bargaining negotiation, it does not need to publicly release the minutes from these executive sessions at this time.

allegations.summary: Complaint raised new allegations about the September 12, 2011 agenda and open session minutes that were not in the original complaint filed with the committee.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review additional allegations raised by the complainant in his January 19, 2012 complaint regarding the Committee's September 12, 2011 agenda and open meeting minutes.
